Hi Aadi —

Thanks for the note and for attaching your copy of the report. We can provide a limited post-period endorsement (bridge letter) that affirms continuity for controls that have not materially changed since the report end date. To do that we typically need:

- A short control-owner attestation (signed by your security/engineering owner) confirming there were no material control design or ownership changes, or enumerating any changes and compensating controls
- A short list of any service changes that could affect control scope (major infra migrations, product re-architectures, new third-party data processors)
- Confirmation whether you require the bridge letter to be notarized or to include your auditor's cover language

Tentative timeline: once we receive the attestation and the change list, we can produce a draft bridge letter in ~3 business days and finalize after your review (~1 additional business day). If your auditor (Crowe) requires wording from them, please flag that and we’ll coordinate.

Looping in Neha (security/compliance) and Rishi (manager) to help assemble the draft and confirm scope.

Next steps: can you send a one-paragraph attestation from your control owner and any items you want explicitly called out?
